retreats.title: 5-Day Yoga Meditation Ayurveda Wellness Retreat
retreats.description: 5-Day Yoga Retreat in Rishikesh at a certified yoga school with Hatha Yoga, meditation, sound healing, Ganga Aarti, Satvic meals & luxury stay.
retreats.overview:
Experience true serenity, quiet, and calm in the foothills of the Himalayas with our 5-day yoga retreat in Rishikesh. Reconnect and rebalance yourself in the lush natural surroundings with trained personnel and gurus to guide your journey inside and out.

Situated in a serene, restorative setting, our yoga center retreat is surrounded by river views, gardens, and sacred spaces where you can learn or perform traditional yogic practices with modern healing therapies. Each day in this 5-day yoga retreat program in Rishikesh is tailored to help you channel your inner energy and unlock your best self.

Our yoga, meditation & self-healing retreat is for anyone and everyone. If you want to escape the everyday stress or want to savor the Himalayan life away from the hustle and bustle of the city, this luxury yoga retreat is for you. No matter if you are a student, yoga teacher, working professional, or just someone who wants to heal emotionally, this retreat offers a safe, nurturing space to slow down, breathe deeply, and realign with yourself.

At Nirvana Yoga School, we believe in offering an experience that remains with you throughout your life - an experience that truly enriches your soul rather than your memory. That is why, through yogic practices, meditations, and culturally immersive programs, we create moments of deep transformation and inner awakening which you can cherish for a lifetime. Here, you wake up to herbal teas, savor sattvic and gluten-free meals, enjoy nature treks in the foothills of the Himalayas, Ganga aartis, and a lot more.

Yes. You will get to learn and practice hatha yoga, yin yoga, pranayama, and guided meditations by renowned teaching staff with years of experience. There will also be sound healing therapies, art workshops, destress, & emotional trauma healing practices to help you release stored stress and reconnect with your true self. This yoga and meditation retreat is perfect for those who want to heal emotionally and mentally.

faqs.question: How do I book my spot?
faqs.answer: To book your seat in our 5-Day yoga retreat program, all you need to do is pay an advance deposit fee of 20% of the total cost. This is necessary so that we can book your seat. The remaining fee can be paid when you arrive. Please note that the advance deposit fee is non-refundable.

faqs.question: Is this retreat family-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes, our 5-day yoga retreat is family-friendly.

faqs.question: How do I reach the school?
faqs.answer: When you arrive at the New Delhi Airport (Indira Gandhi International Airport), book a domestic flight to Dehradun Airport (DED) from Delhi (DEL). From Dehradun Airport, we offer a free taxi pickup service to our yoga retreat at an additional charge of 80 USD. You can also hire local drivers to drop you off in Tapovan, Rishikesh.

faqs.question: Do I need prior yoga experience?
faqs.answer: Absolutely, we offer an experience that is inclusive of everyone, be it beginners or professional yoga teachers.

faqs.question: What should I pack?
faqs.answer: Make sure to bring your clothes and daily essentials, like phone chargers, toiletries, etc. We also advise you to bring yoga clothes. Apart from this, all other things required for the course will be provided by us.

faqs.question: When is the best time to visit Rishikesh?
faqs.answer: The best time to visit Rishikesh is during October to February (Winter Season) and March to June (Summer season). Expect a lot of rain during July and September, which also increases the chances of landslides and roadblocks.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: An advance payment of course fees is non-refundable. In an emergency, students may join us on other schedules. If the student cancels the course, we accept cancellation, but the advance deposit will not be refunded for cancellation.

retreats.title: 7-Day Yoga Meditation Ayurveda Wellness Retreat
retreats.description: 7-Day Yoga Retreat in Rishikesh at a certified yoga school with Hatha Yoga, meditation, sound healing, Ganga Aarti, Satvic meals & Himalayan stay.
retreats.overview:
Give yourself a moment to breathe, relax, and reconnect with our 7-day yoga retreat in Rishikesh. Step away from the noise and enjoy a comfortable stay in the lush green foothills of the Himalayas.

This weeklong yoga retreat in Rishikesh, India, offers you an escape from the buzz of everyday stress through spiritual and yogic practices. Perform hatha, ashtanga, and yin yoga guided by trained gurus with years of experience. Meditate with the sound of the flowing Ganga and nature.

Sooth your soul with kirtans and Ganga aarti, calm your mind with nature walks, and heal your emotions with sound healing therapy, as well as destress & emotional trauma healing workshops. Every day in our yoga retreat center is made to help you reunite with your true sense of self.

This yoga meditation retreat is for everyone, especially those who are looking for a getaway in the Himalayan countryside. Be it a student, yoga teacher, working professional, or just someone who wants to heal emotionally, our retreat program offers an experience tailored for everyone.

We offer a carefully curated experience focused on healing, yogic practices, and cultural immersion. Each day offers something new - be it wellness therapies, yoga, meditation, cultural practices, or excursions into nature. With soulful, sattvic food and lush, natural setting, we ensure that you come as you are and leave spiritually fulfilled and more in tune with yourself.

A number of things! From yoga asanas and Ayurvedic knowledge to what’s locked inside your mind. You’ll gain practical techniques, meditation, emotional balance, and mindful living that you can easily use in your day-to-day life. In the end, it all comes down to what you take from a supportive environment backed by the camaraderie of like-minded people.

faqs.question: How do I book my spot?
faqs.answer: To reserve your spot in our 7-day yoga retreat, simply pay an advance deposit of 20% of the total program fee. This confirms your booking and allows us to secure your accommodation and retreat arrangements. The remaining balance can be paid upon arrival. Please note that the advance deposit is non-refundable.

faqs.question: Is this retreat family-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes, our 7-day yoga retreat program is suitable for families.

faqs.question: How do I reach the school?
faqs.answer: Upon arrival at New Delhi International Airport (DEL), you can take a domestic flight to Dehradun Airport (DED). From Dehradun, we can arrange a comfortable taxi transfer to our retreat center for an additional charge of USD 80. Alternatively, you may hire a local taxi directly to Tapovan, Rishikesh.

faqs.question: Do I need prior yoga experience?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our yoga and meditation retreat in Rishikesh is open to all levels, from complete beginners to experienced practitioners and yoga teachers.
